WITH due AS (
  UPDATE notifications n
  SET last_sent = (now() AT TIME ZONE b.timezone)::date
  FROM bot_users b
  WHERE b.telegram_id = n.telegram_id
    AND b.notify_on
    AND n.enabled
    AND (now() AT TIME ZONE b.timezone) >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE b.timezone)::date + n.notify_time)
    AND (now() AT TIME ZONE b.timezone) <  ((now() AT TIME ZONE b.timezone)::date + n.notify_time + interval '30 minutes')
    AND n.last_sent IS DISTINCT FROM (now() AT TIME ZONE b.timezone)::date
  RETURNING n.id AS notification_id, n.telegram_id, n.location_id
)
SELECT d.notification_id, d.telegram_id, l.id, l.name, l.kind, l.name_prep, l.lat, l.lon,
       p.name AS parent_name, p.type_name AS parent_type, p.lat AS parent_lat, p.lon AS parent_lon,
       (l.parent_id = l.region_id) AS parent_is_region,
       r.name AS region_name, r.type_name AS region_type
FROM due d
JOIN ru_locations l ON l.id = d.location_id
LEFT JOIN ru_locations p ON p.id = l.parent_id
LEFT JOIN ru_locations r ON r.id = l.region_id;

UPDATE ru_locations
SET lat = $2::float8, lon = $3::float8, coord_source = $4, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::uuid AND $5::boolean AND lat IS NULL
RETURNING id;
